notes: «عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); «أخيه» and «أبيه» are bare relations
The Imam Sadiq sits inside the chain after «عن» (narrator); «أمير المؤمنين» appears only in the words after the chain («قال أمير المؤمنين»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The modern collection's compiler is not a transmitter; the «…» elision in the text is left as is
